name: aeo-citability
description: Adds the structured data and clean text surfaces that get pages cited by Perplexity, ChatGPT search and Google AI Overviews: Article/BlogPosting and FAQPage JSON-LD, clean .md siblings, llms.txt and sitemap.xml. Python 3 standard library only, idempotent, no network calls. Audit-first workflow with a 0-100 readiness score per page.
